fn forward(yaw : Float, pitch : Float) : Vec3 do

  Vec3(0.0 -. Math.sin(yaw) *. cp, Math.sin(pitch), 0.0 -. Math.cos(yaw) *. cp)
end

@[no_alloc]
fn record(yaw : Float, pitch : Float, id : Int) : Hit do

parallel.excerpt:
fn inc_parallel(t : Tree) : Tree do
  match t do
  Leaf(n)    -> Leaf(n + 1)
  Node(l, r) ->
    match List.pmap_n([l, r], fn half -> inc_leaves(half), 2) do
    [left, right] -> Node(left, right)
    _ -> panic("two halves")
    end
  end
end

shared.headline: `inc_leaves` builds a new copy instead of reusing `t` in place, because `t` is used again afterwards. [copy_shared]
shared.why_copies:
-- WARNING: COPY --------------------------- shared.march

`inc_leaves` builds a new copy instead of reusing `t` in place, because `t` is used again afterwards. [copy_shared]
A function can update a value in place only when it holds the only reference to it; make this call the last use of `t` and `inc_leaves` reuses its memory instead of allocating.
